description: Get logs for a specific frame with pagination to handle large log volumes

frameIndex.description: The frame index to retrieve logs from (0-based)

limit.description: Maximum number of logs to return (default: 100)

logLevel.description: Filter by log level: error, warn, info, debug, log, or all (default: all)

offset.description: Number of logs to skip (for pagination, default: 0)

searchText.description: Search for specific text in log messages (case insensitive)

name: get_frame_logs_paginated
